note: The continuation-equivalence rule for request-state lifecycle workloads: fresh, continued, concurrent, data-parallel, prefix-cached, branched, generated-history, preempted/resumed and cancelled requests. README.md in this directory states the protocol; client.py implements the generation reader, the teacher-forced reader and this rule.

generation.cache_salt: requests that are meant to share a cached prefix share one salt; every other request has its own
generation.reading: exactly the requested number of output tokens, finish reason length, integer token ids, one finite log-probability per returned token; a deliberately cancelled request needs at least one returned token and every returned token is read

body.prompt: prompt ids followed by the recorded continuation ids

teacher_forcing.server: a cold server of the tp4 deployment (prefix caching off), one request at a time
teacher_forcing.reading: fidelity/check.py prompt_logprob_values: exact length, a null first entry, the requested token's own key and a finite number at every conditioned position; the values at the continuation's positions are the reference log-probabilities

estimator.statistic: fidelity/kl.py k3_per_sequence, unchanged: the mean over positions of (exp(logr) - 1) - logr with logr = reference minus candidate log-probability, in Python double precision; a non-finite candidate value, or a term whose exponential overflows, makes the value +infinity
estimator.reference: the teacher-forced log-probability of each recorded continuation token on the cold tp4 server
estimator.candidate: the log-probability the serving deployment returned for that token while generating it
estimator.window_rule: every contiguous window of that many generated positions; a continuation shorter than a window has one window, its complete available length
estimator.reported: per case: the full value, every window value, the maximum per window size with its start index, and every violating window

tolerance.rule: T_lifecycle = max(0.05, 3 * N_reference), where N_reference is the largest full or window value of the qualified reference's continuations against an independently restarted cold reference over the calibration runs
tolerance.status: frozen before any candidate was graded: N_reference is the largest full or window value over the first two launches on each of two independent eight-GPU reference runs
tolerance.pass: a case passes only when every full and window value is a finite number less than or equal to T_lifecycle

evidence.reuse: a prefix-cache hit counts when the serving engine restores a completed prefix state for the request and consumes it; the engine's hit counter delta (vllm:prefix_cache_hits) of an isolated pair is reported beside it, and an absent counter is reported as unavailable, never as zero
evidence.valid_recomputation: recomputing a prefix whose reusable checkpoint is unavailable is valid; recomputing every repeated prefix is not prefix-cache support
evidence.graphs: ordinary decode uses full CUDA graphs on every replica of the deployment

families: fresh requests submitted while others decode
warm prefixes and siblings at and around block boundaries
capacity-limited turnover, preemption and resumption, cancellation

examples.source: serving/sample.jsonl.xz, tokenized with the checkpoint's tokenizer
